content:
Control Handler

Manages entity control states and transitions.

Component Mob

Schema

JSON
{
  "controlHandler": {
    "defaultState": "idle"
  }
}

Description

The Control Handler component manages entity control states and transitions. It defines the default control state and handles switching between different states during gameplay.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
defaultStatestringThe initial control state the entity starts in.

Example

JSON
{
  "controlHandler": {
    "defaultState": "idle"
  }
}
